name: voiceflow-ai-assistant
description: Voiceflow — a voice-first AI assistant platform with an abstracted provider layer (no paid APIs required).
author: Voiceflow Engineering

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@voiceflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@voiceflow/api && npm run build --workspace=@voiceflow/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@voiceflow/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@voiceflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run build
